findings.issue: Prefetch progress for unfinished tasks is elapsed/measured time (capped 95%), not real work done; doc and CHANGELOG say 'progress is real'.
findings.fix: Reword the claim to 'measured-time weighted, finished stages counted exactly', or report per-chunk completion for colours.

findings.issue: The warm sim is only discarded in _run_build. If the jump is freed or the app quits during prefetch (no _exit_tree), the warm child and worker tasks are orphaned; a failed or raising build also skips nothing but a quit mid-load leaves the child.
findings.fix: Add _exit_tree() in LoadingJump that waits for outstanding worker tasks and calls SimBridge.discard_warm() and CaptainAvatar.clear_offered().

findings.issue: loading_jump is never reset after finish; a second title route in the same Main would skip the jump if a freed instance compares non-null. Currently masked because Esc/Main menu reload the scene (tests only check a fresh Main).
findings.fix: Connect loading_jump.finished to set loading_jump = null, and test it.

findings.issue: Shared-load equality is tested for rows and counters, but the donor is a static weakref to the last loader; any donor whose last_error/other non-snapshotted fields differ is not copied (e.g. last_error). Fine today, fragile if load_tiers gains state.
findings.fix: Add a comment/test that lists the fields load_tiers sets, or assert via a field-diff test against a fresh load.
